identification: Stack of about 11 Tasmanian books and booklets. Only the 1926-27 Tasmanian Government Tourist Dept Hotel and Boarding House Directory (worn, pencil signature) and the 1975 Dr Clifford Craig Collection Vol II auction catalogue have any collector interest; the rest are modern local-interest paperbacks/hardbacks (Meidl, THS 2003, Mures Fish Tales, Brothers' Home, Open to Talent, Subantarctic Wilderness, 1975 Sesquicentenary booklet). Not a first-edition question: the directory is an ephemeral annual, one printing per year.
